observations: Explosive vocabulary is taught on the first screen (Nitro, Aku, TNT in one row).
On ice, sliding is the crate attack; one TNT among slide targets punishes blind sliding.
Teach then twist: arrow + floating striped (S1-b) returns with an off-screen ! above it (S4-f); the bonus rehearses the head-butt that S3-c needs.
Both remote switches need backtracking and both are outside the default camera view (behind the arrival point; above the screen top).
Outline boxes placed before their switch (S4-e) are a visible promise; the first outline set (S3-c) has its switch beside it.
Checkpoints sit right after timed hazards or at the bottom of the free-fall.
The big payout (the wall) is late and guarded by ice momentum plus a penguin.
The only main 1UP is behind the hardest hidden switch.
The optional red-gem course does not add to the box total.
